instructions.base: I'm stocking another kitchen. I have one of these two items in mind for a spare: the frying pan in front of me, or a kitchen knife like the ones on the board behind it. Get one product supplying the item I mean; a retail set is fine. Match its cooking or cutting use, not its brand or colour. Also restock the ground spice from the small spice jar I take out of the cupboard next.

composite_events.request: I would rather store that spice whole and grind it when needed. Replace the ground spice with the same spice in its whole form. Keep the spare item.
Could you also add an electric spice grinder? Pick one whose product details confirm it can grind that spice, and keep the rest of the order as requested.

clarification.canonical_answer: The frying pan in front of me, please.
